definitions.gloss: wiping off; wiping away; removal by wiping
definitions.explanation: The act of cleaning or removing something by wiping with a cloth, tissue, or similar material.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use special wipes to remove makeup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こぼしたら→こぼす：02104_kobosu⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you spill water, please wipe it up right away.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb ⟦{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る→拭き取る：18690_fukitoru⟧ (to wipe off, to wipe away), which combines ⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ (to wipe) and ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take, to remove). The emphasis is on the removal aspect — not just wiping, but wiping something away.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}り⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧: wiping sheet, cleaning wipe
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}り⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: for wiping/cleaning purposes
- {拭|ふ}き{取|と}り⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧: cleaning by wiping
- ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧{拭|ふ}き{取|と}り: makeup removal (by wiping)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{拭|ふ}き{取|と}る→拭き取る：18690_fukitoru⟧: to wipe off (the verb form)
- ⟦{拭|ふ}き{掃除|そうじ}→拭き掃除：18123_fukisouji⟧: wiping/mopping (general wiping as cleaning method)
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧{拭|ぶ}き: damp wiping, wet wiping
- {乾|から}{拭|ぶ}き: dry wiping
